 Follow North West is unrecognizable in reality TV star costume using prosthetic chin
 Taijuan Moorman, USA TODAY Updated Thu, October 22, 2026 at 1:15 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. The 13-year-old master of transformations just made her biggest one yet.
 North West , the daughter of Kim Kardashian and Ye, revealed her first Halloween 2026 costume in a series of TikToks , in which she donned a straight black wig, fake lashes and makeup, "Baddies" chain, Zeus network muscle tee and a comically large prosthetic chin, reminiscent of reality TV star Natalie Nunn .
 In over a dozen TikToks posted Wednesday, Oct. 21, the "Piercing On My Hand" rapper lip-synced Nunn's songs and used audio of the reality star's most notable moments.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Nunn herself quickly reacted to the costume with her approval.
 "GOTTA GET @northwest her baddie chain now!" Nunn wrote on Instagram . "SHE GETS A BADDIE CHAIN HAPPY HALLOWEEN MONTH !!"
 Who is Natalie Nunn?
 Natalie Nunn rose to fame as a cast member on "Bad Girls Club" and, in recent years, as an executive producer and main cast member of Zeus network's "Baddies." She has also gained traction as a rapper, including the TikTok-viral single "Doin What I Want," and in memes, in which her chin has been a frequent topic of conversation. Nicki Minaj referenced this as much in the 2023 track "Endless Fashion."
 Natalie Nunn attends the Zeus Network "Baddies South" Houston premiere at Regal Edwards Greenway Grand Palace ScreenX & RPX on June 12, 2022, in Houston. North noted the look was her first Halloween costume. In past years, Kardashian and Ye's oldest daughter has dressed as TikToker Jay Guapõ , Tyler, The Creator, H.E.R. and Stacey Dash's Dionne , alongside her mom as Alicia Silverstone's Cher, from "Clueless."
 Advertisement Advertisement Kardashian has previously praised her daughter's handiwork. "She's so skilled at special effects makeup. And I love that this is what she is into right now," the Skims founder told People in 2024.
